title: Learning recall quiz
scope: Coverage and answer-key facts; pedagogical quality needs human review

files.inputs/learning-notes.md:
N1: water freezing point in Celsius: 0.
N2: days in a non-leap year: 365.
N3: minutes in an hour: 60.
N4: sides of a hexagon: 6.
N5: millimetres in a centimetre: 10.
N6: hours in a day: 24.

phases.prompt:
Create one recall question for each answerable numbered fact in inputs/learning-notes.md. Save questions.md and answer-key.md separately, each at least 80 characters; questions must not include the answers. The structured result has answers:[{note_id,answer:<number>}], and unanswerable_ids. Use only the notes.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
